title: Lehman Says Diesel, Tariffs Have Been Devastating for Farmers
title_cn: Lehman Says Diesel, Tariffs Have Been Devastating for Farmers
summary: Aaron Lehman, president of the Iowa Farmers Union and fifth-generation farmer in Polk County, Iowa, says both diesel prices and tariffs have been devastating for farmers. Lehman says farmers have not felt that an Iowa voice has been standing up for them in Washington and says that while farmers need relief, temporary measures do not address the underlying causes of their financial strain. Lehman says agriculture has a monopoly problem that leaves farmers especially vulnerable when fertilizer supplies are disrupted. Lehman says he finds President Donald Trump's deal with Russian President Vladimir Putin to try to lower diesel costs disturbing. He speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Farkas Says Starlink Slowdown Helped the Russians

Farkas says Russian President Vladimir Putin continues to signal openness to negotiations while maintaining his maximalist claims and continuing attacks on Ukrainians. Farkas says Putin is trying to get European countries to stop supporting Ukraine and says a diesel deal with President Donald Trump came out of a call between the two leaders. title: Bloomberg Businessweek Daily: SpaceX-Tesla Merger (Podcast)
title_cn: Bloomberg Businessweek Daily: SpaceX-Tesla Merger (Podcast)
summary:
Elon Musk has publicly endorsed a combination of SpaceX and Tesla, his two most valuable companies, in what would be the biggest corporate transaction ever attempted. There's a push to announce a deal by the first half of 2027, so that it closes during the current administration, according to people familiar with the matter, with the combined market value of the companies being around $3.7 trillion. Musk's endorsement comes at a moment of extraordinary influence for him, having repaired his relationship with President Donald Trump and tapped into fervent investor enthusiasm, but this advantage is not guaranteed to last.

On today's episode:

Max Chafkin, Bloomberg Businessweek Senior Reporter
Jackie Reses, co-founder and CEO of Lead
Brett Winton, Chief Futurist, ARK Investment Management
Andra Timu, Bloomberg Reporter covering Romania on Russian Drones Attacking EU (Source: Bloomberg)
